1b0e607c.text:
Hello William,

It's been years since we've spoken, but I trust you and your brother are well, and that your apothecary thrives.

I must ask a favor of you, William.  In short, my grandson Tommy Joe has lost his heart to young Maybell Maclure.  And although they adore each other... our families, well our families have been feuding for years.
1b0e607c.title: Gramma Stonefield's Note

10118|c6fbc16f.name: Nessa Shadowsong
10118|c6fbc16f.text: The fish off the coast of Teldrassil are quite large and robust.  Rumors say it is the speedy growth of our new world tree that is the cause.

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

11050|8b982bde.name: Trianna
11050|8b982bde.text: You will not be disappointed, traveler. Tailoring is a joyous endeavor.

11050|e9e31cca.name: Trianna
11050|e9e31cca.text: There is no greater way to clear the mind than to weave.

11068|bf2f71d7.name: Betty Quin
11068|bf2f71d7.text: Hail, traveler! What brings you to my doorstep?

11070|0809aae8.name: Lalina Summermoon
11070|0809aae8.text: The Goddess has granted me wisdom, stranger. If it is her will, I shall pass it on to you.

11070|d1188d03.name: Lalina Summermoon
11070|d1188d03.text: I will teach you what I can. Each lesson is a gift from the Goddess herself. Use her gifts wisely, and you shall not falter.

11401|fed57ab8.name: Priestess Alathea
11401|fed57ab8.text: My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $N?

11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

1300|d1216699.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|d1216699.text: Life is like a carefully woven tapestry.

1314|0624ab70.name: Duncan Cullen
1314|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1318|23d8b931.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1347|0624ab70.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

2080|ac9bd966.name: Denalan
2080|ac9bd966.text: The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

268047|53fff4bc.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

2913|5112b624.name: Archaeologist Hollee
2913|5112b624.text: Who would have guessed the excavation would have uncovered such findings!

3567|b367f6df.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|b367f6df.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that priests like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3600|fed57ab8.name: Laurna Morninglight
3600|fed57ab8.text: My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $N?

3607|c2467ddc.name: Androl Oakhand
3607|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4091|fed57ab8.name: Jandria
4091|fed57ab8.text: My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $N?

4092|fed57ab8.name: Lariia
4092|fed57ab8.text: My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $N?

4155|c78f83ac.name: Idriana
4155|c78f83ac.text: Welcome to the Bank of Darnassus. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

4165|1c7cd7a4.name: Elissa Dumas
4165|1c7cd7a4.text: I do not believe you possess the mental acuity to grasp the nature of portal magic.

4200|c2e88775.name: Laird
4200|c2e88775.text: Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.

4210|0c543544.name: Alegorn
4210|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4213|bbaf25e8.name: Taladan
4213|bbaf25e8.text: You have not yet learned the basics, wanderer. Have you spoken to my assistant, Lalina Summermoon? Perhaps you should.

4241|b0e0696e.name: Mydrannul
4241|b0e0696e.text: It is my honor to provide for adventurers, for they are heroes in the making.

4262|1a4941ed.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|1a4941ed.text: I'm flattered, but really I'm not interested... What?  You want to know where to learn enchanting?  Oh, how embarrassing!  Well, you should...  I'm sure you could... go see, um...  Taladan!  Yes, see Taladan over in the Craftsmen's Terrace!

4262|21ab523d.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|21ab523d.text: Here in Darnassus you will find skilled trainers who have perfected the skills of their chosen class through ages of training and dedication.  I will guide you to one who can become your mentor, you have but to name your chosen path.

4262|ce424d00.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

4262|d3a25a4e.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|d3a25a4e.text: Alegorn is a masterful chef who has had centuries with which to perfect his cooking.  You should consider yourself blessed should he decide to teach you.  If you believe you are worthy, you can find him in the Craftsmen's Terrace.

4262|e07232c6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e07232c6.text: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?

4262|e74436e4.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e74436e4.text: With the garments that Me'Lynn tailors, one might think that her needle was blessed by Elune herself.  Unless your needle is so blessed, you best pay her a visit and listen to her teachings.  You can find her in The Craftsmen's Terrace in northeastern Darnassus.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5496|86b6c1ef.name: Sandahl
5496|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5500|ae60e9f0.name: Tel'Athir
5500|ae60e9f0.text: Ishnu-alah, sister. Have you any tidings from abroad? My heart yearns for news of Teldrassil.

5503|01ed62ab.name: Eldraeith
5503|01ed62ab.text: Made by the finest craftsmen in all of Teldrassil, carried by hand from Kalimdor to Azeroth as a sign of the growing alliance between the people of the Great Tree and the humans of this land. If there is anything you require, you have but to ask.

5520|721fd095.name: Spackle Thornberry
5520|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

5566|bb901712.name: Tannysa
5566|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

6094|a28d29e1.name: Byancie
6094|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6286|f842f7e5.name: Zarrin
6286|f842f7e5.text: Hello, $N. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.

6736|41276936.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
6736|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6737|41276936.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

68|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

68|4fc5af49.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4fc5af49.text: Ah, you're looking for Lucan Cordell.  He runs a shop on the outside of the Magic Quarter on your way to the Stockade.

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

1001-accept.name: Unknown
1001-accept.text:
A tiny voice crackles from deep within the machine.

"Wizbang here! The next Buzzbox is north of Auberdine, on the beach

So, that Buzzbox is number 411 and it needs 3 Thresher Eyes for its repairs. They're just off the coast! The darkshore threshers... *Hic*... Sorry about that...

Just like last time, when you give the Buzzbox the goods, it'll spit out your reward. *Hic*... What? No, I'm fine!"
1001-accept.title: Buzzbox 411

106-accept.name: Maybell Maclure
106-accept.text:
Oh, I'm cursed!  My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies.  So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!

Please, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe.  He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.
106-accept.title: Young Lovers

106-complete.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-complete.text: Ah!  I can't stand us being apart.  I have to see her!!
106-complete.title: Young Lovers

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-accept.name: Gramma Stonefield
107-accept.text:
I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!

Here, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
107-accept.title: Note to William

107-complete.name: William Pestle
107-complete.text:
My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe.  I remember being young and in love, once.

There must be something I can do to help them!  Let me think...
107-complete.title: Note to William

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

109-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

1097-accept.name: Smith Argus
1097-accept.text:
There's a dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, Grimand Elmore, who sent word that he needs help with a delivery.  I believe he wants a package sent to his homeland in the north.

You have a sturdy pair on you!  So if you're interested in some legwork then speak with Grimand.  We could use you down here, but we must also keep our ties strong with the dwarves.

You can find Grimand Elmore at the weapon shop in the Dwarven District of Stormwind, in the northeast section of town.
1097-accept.title: Elmore's Task

111-accept.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
111-accept.text:
Please, $N, talk with my Gramma.  If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.

She's inside our house east of here.
111-accept.title: Speak with Gramma

111-complete.name: Gramma Stonefield
111-complete.text:
While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.

Hm, what can we do...
111-complete.title: Speak with Gramma

112-accept.name: William Pestle
112-accept.text:
I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe.  But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.

Although the kelp usually grows in the ocean... sometimes murlocs collect it.  See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any.  Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.
112-accept.title: Collecting Kelp

1141-accept.name: Gubber Blump
1141-accept.text:
I love fishing.  The Blump family is known for fishing.  My name is Gubber Blump; I fish.

There's a kind of fish I like to catch around these parts called Darkshore grouper.  I used to go out on a boat to fish for grouper, but no boats have been going out since them mean ol' murlocs moved in.  I bet they been eating up all the grouper too.

Say, you wanna help me catch Darkshore grouper?  I'd give you a bona fide Blump Family Fishing Pole if you did!  It's a real good pole to catch fish with.
1141-accept.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

1688-accept.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1688-accept.text:
I had a student named Surena Caledon. She stood where you stand now, eager to learn of $c magic, and possessing no small bit of talent. More than that she was young and pleasing to the eye. Had I seen it then, the traitorous trollop!

The thieving wench ran off with one of the Defias, Erlan Drudgemoor. While her loss is of little importance, I gifted her a bloodstone choker that I must have.

Her life means nothing to me now. You will find her at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. Retrieve what is mine.
1688-accept.title: Surena Caledon

2159-progress.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
2159-progress.text: How might I be of service to you, young one?  Are you here to rest in the inn?  Do you require a hearthstone?
2159-progress.title: Dolanaar Delivery

239-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
239-accept.text:
The Garrison on our western border sends word of increasing gnoll and thief activity.  They're requesting we send more Stormwind soldiers... but we just don't have any to spare!

If you can help, we could use it.  Go and speak with Deputy Rainer at the Westbrook Garrison and see what he needs done.

The Garrison is down the road to the west.  After you cross the bridge over the small brook it will be to the right.
239-accept.title: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!

2399-complete.name: Unknown
2399-complete.text: The fronds Denalan planted within his garden have sprouted and grown.  They tremble, eager to be picked....
2399-complete.title: The Sprouted Fronds

2438-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-accept.text:
I was once given an emerald dreamcatcher from Gaerolas Talvethen, the warden of the druids in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. This powerful amulet is able to siphon energy from the Emerald Dream, bestowing luck upon those who carry it.

Sadly, I have not been able to retrieve it from my dresser in Starbreeze Village... Although Starbreeze was once a tranquil place, it has now succumbed to the corruption of the furbolg that reside there.

Perhaps you would be willing to recover my dreamcatcher, $c?
2438-accept.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2438-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-progress.text:
Please move swiftly. I can only hope that my emerald dreamcatcher has been unharmed by the furbolg.

Have you recovered it yet, $N?
2438-progress.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2498-accept.name: Rellian Greenspyre
2498-accept.text:
I have just received word that  Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth has discovered what may be the cause of the tumors that plague the timberlings. Please speak with him, and tell him I sent you.

Make haste, $N; he needs our help.
2498-accept.title: Return to Denalan

2518-accept.name: Priestess A'moora
2518-accept.text:
Lady Sathrah was once beloved of Elune. Graceful and pure, the spider spun her silver threads through the moonlight, catching the evening mist. The silvery dew had strong healing powers and was kept here in the temple.

But of late, Sathrah has descended into madness. Her future generations are now threatened as well.

Find Lady Sathrah, $N, and end her suffering. She dwells along the northern borders of Teldrassil, near Wellspring Lake. Gather her silvery spinnerets and bring them back to me.
2518-accept.title: Tears of the Moon

2541-accept.name: Oben Rageclaw
2541-accept.text:
The Gnarlpine shaman that inhabit this place have discovered a way of separating a sleeping druid's spirit from the physical body. The furbolg have animated my physical form and are using it to attack anyone that attempts to explore the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. I am now trapped in the Emerald Dream, powerless to stop this.

You must help me. The Gnarlpine shaman carry a strange charm which is used to perform this ritual, and I'd like to examine it. Please, $N, bring one to me.
2541-accept.title: The Sleeping Druid

2541-progress.name: Oben Rageclaw
2541-progress.text: If I can examine the charm, I may be able to figure out how to break the enchantment. Have you found one?
2541-progress.title: The Sleeping Druid

3524-accept.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-accept.text:
Majestic sea creatures are known to launch themselves at the Darkshore coastline, beached there until they die. Lately, these beasts have been washing ashore in ever-increasing numbers.  I've been sent here by the Temple of the Moon to investigate, but the presence of murlocs along the water has made my research difficult.

There is a giant creature washed ashore just south of Auberdine that is ringed by the foul Greymist murlocs.  Could you go there and retrieve bones from the creature for our study?
3524-accept.title: Washed Ashore

4161-progress.name: Zarrin
4161-progress.text: Remember the balance, $N. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
4161-progress.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4811-accept.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4811-accept.text:
Hostile moonkin roam in ever increasing numbers to our east.  They once were thought to be gentle, almost mystical creatures.  While some continue to hold reverence for them, the safety of Auberdine forces me to keep a more realistic view.

I've received reports that moonkin are being drawn to a large red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range.  No one has any idea what that crystal is, or even if it really exists.  I want you to locate it over there and report back to me what you find.
4811-accept.title: The Red Crystal

483-complete.name: Athridas Bearmantle
483-complete.text: You have succeeded, young $c!  Well done.  And just in time I might add.
483-complete.title: The Relics of Wakening

483-progress.name: Athridas Bearmantle
483-progress.text:
$N, the kidnapped Druids of the Talon will be forever trapped in the Emerald Dream if we cannot retrieve the Relics of Wakening from the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.

For every minute we delay their fate comes one step closer to eternal doom.
483-progress.title: The Relics of Wakening

486-accept.name: Athridas Bearmantle
486-accept.text:
Now the time has come to save the Druids of the Talon. If we fail now, $N, they will be forever lost in sleep.

I shall prepare the Relics of Wakening and perform the ritual. For my work to take effect, the cursed beast responsible for this horrible situation must be slain. Only then will the ritual be complete.

It was Ursal the Mauler who meddled with our brethren's calling and it is Ursal the Mauler who must now pay so they can be freed. Travel to Gnarlpine Hold in the southwest and slay him.
486-accept.title: Ursal the Mauler

488-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-progress.text: Have you been a busy little bee, $N?  I've been waiting for you to bring me what I need.
488-progress.title: Zenn's Bidding

489-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?  A lovely snack I presume?
489-progress.title: Seek Redemption!

490-accept.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-accept.text:
By strict orders from the Sentinels, I am commissioning a bounty on the Gnarlpine. They are no longer friends of the forest. Their corruption has left them mindless threats to our people and the creatures of the glade.

As decreed, you shall be rewarded for removing the furbolg menaces from Teldrassil. Bring to me their fangs as proof of your deeds.

You will find furbolg concentrated in Ban'ethil Hollow, west of Dolanaar and south of the road, and in Starbreeze Village to the east.
490-accept.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

490-complete.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-complete.text: You have served well, $N. You shall be rewarded for your contribution.
490-complete.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

490-progress.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-progress.text: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.
490-progress.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

5621-accept.name: Laurna Morninglight
5621-accept.text:
I need your help, $N. I am needed here to train the other students, but you, you can help one of our injured Sentinels just south of Dolanaar. She was hurt patrolling the town and could use our aid. Her name is Shaya.

When you find her, heal her wounds, and then fortify her body with your spells. This will at least protect her from harm longer if she finds trouble. Return to me here after you've done your duty to Elune.
5621-accept.title: Garments of the Moon

5621-complete.name: Laurna Morninglight
5621-complete.text:
You have done well and you have served Elune. For that, I thank you.

Please, take this robe as a token of my thanks. It signifies you have earned your place among our order. If you wish, wear it with pride, but either way, we will always recognize you as one of our own.

Go with Elune, $N, and thank you.
5621-complete.title: Garments of the Moon

5622-complete.name: Laurna Morninglight
5622-complete.text: I'm happy to see Shanda has sent you to find me, $N. Teaching young priestesses the ways of Elune gives me great satisfaction.
5622-complete.title: In Favor of Elune

5629-accept.name: Laurna Morninglight
5629-accept.text: Hello again, $N. I know you've been busy aiding our people, but you must take some time for yourself also. Priestess Alathea sent someone here looking for you. It seems that you've caught the attention of our elders and they feel you are prepared for greater things. Head to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus and look for Alathea there. She will be waiting. Good luck, and may Elune be with you.
5629-accept.title: Returning Home

5629-complete.name: Priestess Alathea
5629-complete.text: Wonderful, you've returned, $N. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.
5629-complete.title: Returning Home

61-complete.name: Morgan Pestle
61-complete.text: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around!  I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
61-complete.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

6341-accept.name: Nessa Shadowsong
6341-accept.text:
The fishermen of Rut'theran village do very well, for the fish here are extremely large and abundant.  I would like to compare the bounty here with that of the mainland.

I have a collection of fish bones and scales that I would like taken to a colleague of mine in Darkshore.  His name is Laird, he is a fish vendor in the village of Auberdine.

Bring my collection to our hippogryph master, Vesprystus, and speak to him about traveling to Auberdine.
6341-accept.title: The Bounty of Teldrassil

6341-complete.name: Vesprystus
6341-complete.text: Ah, you wish to get this to Auberdine?  Very well...
6341-complete.title: The Bounty of Teldrassil

6341-progress.name: Vesprystus
6341-progress.text: How may I help you?  Are you in need of transport?
6341-progress.title: The Bounty of Teldrassil

6342-accept.name: Vesprystus
6342-accept.text:
From Rut'theran, there are two methods of travel to Auberdine: by ferry and by hippogryph.  Both are quick and reliable, but if you have not yet flown to Auberdine by hippogryph, then I suggest you do.

It is sound advice to speak with the hippogryph master in every town that has one.  Once you speak to the master, you can then fly there from other towns.

Here is Nessa's collection.  Speak with me again when you are ready to fly to Auberdine and deliver Nessa's collection to Laird.
6342-accept.title: Flight to Auberdine

6342-complete.name: Laird
6342-complete.text:
A package from Nessa?  Thank you, $N!  She told me she would send me samples of the fish caught near Rut'theran village.  She thinks they may be very different from the fish caught here...

My!  This jawbone is nearly twice the size of the same fish found here.  And these scales are as big as a closed fist!  Amazing!
6342-complete.title: Flight to Auberdine

6342-progress.name: Laird
6342-progress.text: Have you come from Teldrassil?  Tell me, how is the fishing there?
6342-progress.title: Flight to Auberdine

6343-accept.name: Laird
6343-accept.text:
I must send a response to Nessa.  She'll be very interested to know how different the fish here are from those along Teldrassil's coastline.  We can only guess the cause, but it is my suspicion that the world tree itself is affecting the wildlife around it!

Please, take this response to Nessa.  If you wish to take a hippogryph back to Rut'theran then speak with the hippogryph master Caylais Moonfeather.  If you wish to take the ferry, then one regularly departs from the dock to the northwest.
6343-accept.title: Return to Nessa

6343-complete.name: Nessa Shadowsong
6343-complete.text:
This is very interesting.  The fish here are large, but I didn't think the difference in bounties between here and the mainland was so great.  There must be a reason for this...

Well thank you, $N.  I will discuss with the villagers the news you brought.  Perhaps, one day, we will find the root of this oddity.  But until then, we shall reap its benefits!
6343-complete.title: Return to Nessa

6343-progress.name: Nessa Shadowsong
6343-progress.text: $N, you're back from Auberdine?  Did you speak with Laird?
6343-progress.title: Return to Nessa

6344-accept.name: Mydrannul
6344-accept.text:
A friend of mine, Nessa Shadowsong, is a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village.  She needs a parcel taken to Darkshore, and is looking for someone to help her.

If you're interested, then to reach Nessa you must take the portal in Darnassus to Rut'theran Village.  You will find the portal west of the Temple Gardens.
6344-accept.title: Nessa Shadowsong

6344-complete.name: Nessa Shadowsong
6344-complete.text: Yes, I have need of a courier who will take a package to Darkshore.  Will you help me?
6344-complete.title: Nessa Shadowsong

7383-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-progress.text: Along with the druids, the Oracle Tree and the Arch Druid have been carefully monitoring the growth of Teldrassil. But though we have a new home, our immortal lives have not been restored.
7383-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

76-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
76-complete.text:
Kobolds at the Jasperlode Mine, you say?  Curses!  The situation is worsening by the minute!

Thank you for the report, $N.  But I wish that the news you brought was good news.
76-complete.title: The Jasperlode Mine

84-accept.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
84-accept.text: Here you go.  And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!
84-accept.title: Back to Billy

84-complete.name: Billy Maclure
84-complete.text:
Mm, yum!  This pie is the best!

I think my memory is coming back to me...
84-complete.title: Back to Billy

84-progress.name: Billy Maclure
84-progress.text: Ugh... I'm starving!  Do you have that pie for me, $N?
84-progress.title: Back to Billy

85-accept.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
85-accept.text:
I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it!  He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here. 

Get my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
85-accept.title: Lost Necklace

85-complete.name: Billy Maclure
85-complete.text:
You lost a what?  Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!

I might know who did but...<grin>...I'm too hungry to remember.
85-complete.title: Lost Necklace

86-accept.name: Billy Maclure
86-accept.text:
Maybe if I got a pie, I could tell you who has that necklace.  And you know, I think that old Bernice lady at that other farm makes great Pork Belly Pies... 

Maybe if you gave her some chunks of boar meat from the boars that hang around our farms, and told her what it was for, she'd bake up a pie for you.
86-accept.title: Pie for Billy

86-complete.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-complete.text: Though this wild boar meat is tough, simmer it enough and it sure does make for some tasty pie!
86-complete.title: Pie for Billy

86-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-progress.text:
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!

Do you have that boar meat?
86-progress.title: Pie for Billy

87-accept.name: Billy Maclure
87-accept.text:
I was playing near the Fargodeep Mine, and I think I dropped, er...I mean I saw, the old lady's necklace.  Don't ask me how it got there...it wasn't me!

Well anyway, I saw this big, gold-toothed kobold pick up the necklace and run into the mine.  Go find that kobold and you'll find the necklace, I swear!
87-accept.title: Goldtooth

87-complete.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-complete.text:
Oh, you found it!  Thank you, thank you dear!

Here, take this.  It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky.  If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign! *sniff*
87-complete.title: Goldtooth

87-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found my necklace?
87-progress.title: Goldtooth

87288-progress.name: Aldia
87288-progress.text: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
87288-progress.title: Soft Saber Pelts

88-accept.name: Ma Stonefield
88-accept.text:
The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess.  The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!

So before she comes to our fields...Princess must die!  Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!

Princess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm.  Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!
88-accept.title: Princess Must Die!

88-complete.name: Ma Stonefield
88-complete.text:
Thank goodness!  That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop!  Thank you, $N.

Now, do either of these suit you?
88-complete.title: Princess Must Die!

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

918-progress.name: Denalan
918-progress.text: Do you have the seeds?  I am eager to plant them.
918-progress.title: Timberling Seeds

919-progress.name: Denalan
919-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found any sprouts near the waters?
919-progress.title: Timberling Sprouts

921-progress.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-progress.text:
The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
921-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

922-complete.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-complete.text:
Ah, a timberling seed?  I wanted to try growing one of these to help Denalan with his studies.

But I'm afraid I've discovered that a corruption has grown in many of the timberlings, and seeds from such creatures carry their parent's taint.  They are beyond my talents to repair.

Denalan is very skilled with things that grow.  He may find a cure for future timberlings.  He may be their only hope.
922-complete.title: Rellian Greenspyre

922-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-progress.text:
Hello...

And how may I help you?
922-progress.title: Rellian Greenspyre

923-accept.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-accept.text:
There is a malevolence growing in the timberlings.  We are trying to find the source, but until we do...in order to keep Teldrassil safe we must cut down the timberlings who are beyond help.  Those that wander Wellspring Lake in northern Teldrassil are the most tainted.  They must be removed!

Destroy the Timberlings you find there, and gather the mossy tumors growing upon them.  Bring the tumors to me so that they may be burned.
923-accept.title: Tumors

923-complete.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-complete.text:
Well done!  These tumors are the symptom of the timberling's disease.  They are filled with a poison that we must cleanse from our new land.

I will dispose of these tumors.  Thank you, $N.
923-complete.title: Tumors

923-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-progress.text: Have you been to Wellspring Lake, $N?  Have you been hunting the timberlings there?
923-progress.title: Tumors

928-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
928-progress.text: Greetings, $c. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?
928-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

929-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-progress.text: Hello again, $N. Have you completed your task?
929-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

930-complete.name: Denalan
930-complete.text:
You found this on Teldrassil?  Intriguing... this fruit is exotic.  Perhaps its seeds were brought here from far off.  Perhaps even as far as Azeroth!  And there's something about this fruit... it seems to have reacted very strangely with the soil of Teldrassil.

Thank you, $N.  Now if you'll excuse me, I must study this further...
930-complete.title: The Glowing Fruit

930-progress.name: Denalan
930-progress.text: $N, you look like you have something to tell me.  Do you have news concerning the timberlings?
930-progress.title: The Glowing Fruit

931-accept.name: Unknown
931-accept.text:
The fronds on this plant shimmer in the forest light, giving it a twisting, pulsing aura.

You believe that Denalan would want a specimen of this.
931-accept.title: The Shimmering Frond

931-complete.name: Denalan
931-complete.text:
Where did you get this?  I haven't seen a plant like this since a sojourn I made to the Swamp of Sorrows... decades ago!  It's amazing that a specimen made its way to Teldrassil.  And it's grown to such a size!

Thank you, $N.  Forgive my shortness of words, but there is a test I would like to perform on this frond...
931-complete.title: The Shimmering Frond

932-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-progress.text: Did you kill Lord Melenas yet? It is vital that he be taken care of quickly and quietly, $N. His continued existence is an embarrassment to us all.
932-progress.title: Twisted Hatred

933-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-progress.text: At first the reports of crazed furbolg attacks were dismissed. Who could have thought that the peace-loving bear-men would turn to mindless rage? Yet another of the problems that plagues us here in our new home.
933-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

937-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-progress.text: Their slashing talons and piercing beaks may prove a difficult match for your own abilities, $N, but I have faith that you will not fail in this task.
937-progress.title: The Enchanted Glade

940-accept.name: Unknown
940-accept.text:
The forest whispers of your feats of valor, $N. As I felt the harpies forced from their nests, a greater calm spread across the forest, its creatures once again feeling safe. I have feared sending another messenger to the Arch Druid, but I know that you will see my message safely to him.

Deliver this to him and know that the forest will see you safely along its paths to the forest of stone.
940-accept.title: Teldrassil

940-complete.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
940-complete.text:
I wondered why the Oracle Tree had not communicated with me for so long... It seems that some problems are lessened while others grow to greater concerns.

I fear my work on Teldrassil shall never be completed, and our immortality never restored.

Nonetheless, you have done the Oracle Tree's task well, and should be rewarded for your diligence.
940-complete.title: Teldrassil

940-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
940-progress.text: Hmm... You come with the spirit of the forest strongly within you, $c. What business do you have with the Arch Druid of the Kaldorei?
940-progress.title: Teldrassil

947-accept.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-accept.text:
I am devising a potion that requires rare mushrooms, mushrooms that grow only in a certain cave.  The cave lies behind Cliffspring Falls, to the east and slightly north along the mountains.

I would go there myself, but I was advised by the Grove of the Ancients to stay away from that place.  Our venerable allies sense that the cave is the hiding place for a new evil in Darkshore.

Please, $N, gather the mushrooms for me.  And while doing so, scout the cave to confirm the Ancients' fears.
947-accept.title: Cave Mushrooms

952-accept.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
952-accept.text:
If you had enough time to run messages for the Oracle Tree, then I'm sure that I can press you into service to deliver a message to the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, due south of Auberdine.

You will most likely have to secure transport on a hippogryph, but I have faith enough in you that you can manage that. Take this to Onu, the Ancient of Lore. He has been awaiting word from me, even as I waited for news from the Oracle Glade.
952-accept.title: Grove of the Ancients

954-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
954-accept.text:
The ruins of Bashal'Aran to the east are overrun with demonic minions. The sprites and satyrs that have taken up residence in the area feed upon the magical energies of the area, their powers growing from continued exposure.

Even with that, I have noticed that there is one shrine they will not approach. On the western side of the ruins, atop a small bluff, a strange blue aura permeates... There must be an explanation to the demons' reluctance.

I would like you to investigate it.
954-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

958-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-accept.text:
$C. A task I would ask of you.

Have you seen the ruins of Ameth'Aran? If not, you will find them on the eastern side of the main road, some ways to the south. Once they were the home of many powerful Highborne, now they are a testament to the destruction their dabblings produced.

I have been told by the Sentinels that the spirits of the Highborne persist, and that they wield their ancient magical implements. Those relics must be appropriated, so that we might destroy them.
958-accept.title: Tools of the Highborne

963-accept.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-accept.text:
In the aftermath of the battles at the Well of Eternity, I heard that Ameth'Aran had been destroyed, its people dead, including my love, Anaya.

I would never have thought, thousands of years later, that memories of Anaya would still haunt my dreams. Wandering the woods of Darkshore in a stupor, I found myself in the ruins of Ameth'Aran... where I saw the haunted spirit of my beloved.

She must be freed, but I lack the heart to do it. Her spirit must be destroyed.
963-accept.title: For Love Eternal

96630-progress.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96630-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96630-progress.title: The Adventurer

97940-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97940-accept.text:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97940-accept.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97950-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97950-accept.text:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97950-accept.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

97950-complete.name: Trianna
97950-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97950-complete.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

983-accept.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
983-accept.text:
Hey! Help me with my latest invention, the buzzbox. You can talk to people far away!

Maybe you've already seen them, they're boxes with levers on them. The only problem is they need constant maintenance.

Each one suffers from a different problem, but I made a really smart decision. I placed each one near creatures that have the proper parts to fix that particular machine. Right now Buzzbox 827 is on the fritz. It's just south of Auberdine, real close. It takes 6 Crawler Legs to fix it. I'll pay ya...
983-accept.title: Buzzbox 827

983-complete.name: Unknown
983-complete.text:
As you place the Crawler Legs inside the machine, you hear gears begin to grind. Judging from the banging sounds coming from the Buzzbox, you believe the Crawler Legs are being put in their proper place. Soon the machine begins to hum, and you hear a tiny voice calling out from within.

"Hello? Uhh... Hello! You fixed it! This is Wizbang by the way! Thanks a lot... Hey, you wouldn't want to fix another one, would ya?"
983-complete.title: Buzzbox 827

983-progress.name: Unknown
983-progress.text: Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.
983-progress.title: Buzzbox 827

98391-accept.name: Laurna Morninglight
98391-accept.text:
Blessings to you, fellow $c. Our Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391-accept.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

98392-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-progress.text: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
98392-progress.title: Darkness in the Glade

98403-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-progress.text:
<Tallonkai lowers his voice.>

Does Xethorr still walk freely?
98403-progress.title: Twisted Hatred
